page.overview:
Who is Ice Beasts?

Ice Beasts are yeti-like creatures that the Edenian warrior Taven encounters in the Konquest mode of Mortal Kombat: Armageddon. They are slow, but powerful and deadly. They are encountered on the way to the Lin Kuei Palace in Arctika.
